supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.sourceGoal: Let’s find fractions and whole numbers that are equivalent. Required Preparation CCSS Standards Addressing 3.NF.A.3.c Lesson Timeline Warm-up 10 min Activity 1 20 min Activity 2 15 min Lesson Synthesis 10 min Cool-down 5 min Teacher Reflection Quest
supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.sourceLearningGoals: Express whole numbers as fractions. Recognize fractions that are equivalent to whole numbers.
teachingSteps: Identify the whole and divide it into equal parts.
Represent the fraction with a number line or equal-area drawing.
Explain the unit fractions, position, equality or comparison.
